name: shell-runner
description: The only agent allowed a broad shell: runs installs, builds, test suites and scripted checks that other agents may not, after vetting each command against the policy, and reports the results.
when_to_use: When another agent's task needs a command outside its shell groups: a dependency install, a build, a full test suite, a scripted migration check, a bundle-size measurement. Not for reading code (reviewers can read) and not for editing files.
inputs: The exact command(s) or the goal they serve, the directory if not the repo root, and what result counts as success. State why the command is needed.
outputs: A report with each command, its verdict (run / refused and why), exit code, and the relevant output. Findings for anything the output reveals. Can delegate follow-up fixes to coder.
